layouts.name: Connected course candidate
layouts.description: Draft OSM course selection. Named-layout and direction confirmation is still required.

layouts.name: Geoparc Long
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Long outer configuration, Short outer configuration, Infield crossing configuration, Infield direct configuration, Central curved configuration, Curved short configuration. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Geoparc Short
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Curved short configuration, Infield crossing configuration, Infield direct configuration. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Long outer configuration
layouts.description: The complete outer main-course perimeter shown in the operator plan, retaining the northern extension and southern return. The western paddock link, eastern pit access and interior variants are excluded.

layouts.name: Short outer configuration
layouts.description: The outer perimeter closes through the direct central northern connection shown among the operator modular variants; the northern extension is excluded. This is a branch description, with lap direction remaining draft.

layouts.name: Infield crossing configuration
layouts.description: The southern infield circuit retains its independently mapped grade-separated diagonal crossing, shown as the karting configuration within the operator main-course plan. The parallel eastern access loop is excluded.

layouts.name: Infield direct configuration
layouts.description: The alternative southern infield circuit uses the direct western connector, upper infield arc and lower infield return shown in the operator configuration plan. No paddock or parallel pit access is included.

layouts.name: Central curved configuration
layouts.description: The operator modular plan retains the central curved return, connecting the western middle-course branch to the eastern main straight. Exact repeated source-node joins close this course; the western short-course connector remains a separate variant.

layouts.name: Curved short configuration
layouts.description: The shorter southern main-course loop retains the central curved return and western modular connector shown in the operator plan. Both the far northern extension and its direct triangular return are excluded. Parallel eastern pit access is excluded.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap connected course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact source-node geometry from the pinned country extract. Configuration is a draft match using a private timing position and nominal layout distance.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap identified course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact pinned source ways from the component recipes; independent paths have no invented joins.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The Long entry is a configuration network with the far northern extension, central direct and curved returns, western modular connector and southern infield crossing variants. These branches are identified by the operator modular-course and karting plan. The parallel eastern access loop is excluded. This is not a single lap. The independent mapped branch distance differs from the catalogue scalar; fine historical alignment remains draft. The independent unique branch distance is 2971.6 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap identified course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact pinned source ways from the component recipes; independent paths have no invented joins.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The Short entry is the southern configuration network: the curved central return and western modular connector close the short main course, with the southern infield crossing variants also represented. The far northern extension, its direct triangular return and parallel eastern access loop are excluded. The operator modular-course and karting plan identifies those branches. This is not a single lap; fine historical alignment remains draft. The independent unique branch distance is 1689.7 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
